title: Literature disclosure warnings (model prior)
description: Model-recalled, conservative disclosures about the published human literature behind ONE ingredient: who funds its trials, and whether the published record shows signs of selective reporting. Displayed under a 'model knowledge, unverified' badge; never enters a score, an arc or a dose band. `unknown` is the default whenever the model is not sure; `concern` requires a specific, widely-reported reason, never a vague impression.

funding_independence.description: Who funded the trials behind this ingredient. `concern` only for a specific, named reason (industry/trade-body funding dominates the trial base, or a specific brand funds most positive trials) -- never a claim that a result is wrong.

publication_bias.description: Whether the published record for this ingredient shows signs of selective reporting (funnel-plot asymmetry, an Egger's test, many small positive trials and few nulls). `concern` only for a specific, describable signal -- never a claim that a result is wrong.
